name: Direct Evidence for Neutrino Flavor Transformation from Neutral-Current Interactions in the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory

date.locator: SNO collaboration web site, news list, entry 'April 20, 2002'
date.note: Announcement date: SNO's own web site lists the neutral-current and day/night results as released on 20 April 2002. The paper (arXiv:nucl-ex/0204008) was submitted to arXiv on 21 April 2002 (v1) and published as Phys. Rev. Lett. 89, 011301 (2002).

announced.locator: SNO collaboration web site, news list, entry 'April 20, 2002'

title: Direct Evidence for Neutrino Flavor Transformation from Neutral-Current Interactions in the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory

claim.quote: Direct Evidence for Neutrino Flavor Transformation from Neutral-Current Interactions in the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory

summary.plain: SNO measured solar neutrinos with the neutral-current reaction on deuterium, which is equally sensitive to all active neutrino flavours. Its non-electron-flavour component came out 5.3 standard deviations above zero, which the collaboration calls strong evidence for solar electron-neutrino flavour transformation; the total flux agreed with solar models.
summary.technical: Observations of neutral-current (NC) interactions on deuterium. Using the NC, elastic-scattering and charged-current reactions and assuming the standard 8B shape (5 MeV kinetic-energy threshold), the electron-neutrino component of the 8B flux is 1.76±0.05(stat)±0.09(syst) ×10^6 cm^-2 s^-1 and the non-electron-neutrino component is 3.41±0.45(stat)+0.48/-0.45(syst) ×10^6 cm^-2 s^-1, 5.3 standard deviations above zero; the total flux measured with the NC reaction, 5.09 (+0.44/-0.43 stat, +0.46/-0.43 syst) ×10^6 cm^-2 s^-1, is consistent with solar models.

why_it_matters.value: The title calls the result direct evidence for neutrino flavor transformation, and the abstract says the non-electron-neutrino component, 5.3 standard deviations above zero, provides strong evidence for solar electron neutrino flavor transformation; the total flux measured with the NC reaction is consistent with solar models.
why_it_matters.quote: 5.3 standard deviations greater than zero, providing strong evidence for solar electron neutrino flavor transformation. The total flux measured with the NC reaction is 5.09 +0.44,-0.43(stat.)+0.46,-0.43(syst.)x10^6/(cm^2 s), consistent with solar models.

key_value_text.value: Non-electron flux 3.41 ×10^6 cm^-2 s^-1, 5.3σ > 0; total NC flux 5.09 ×10^6 cm^-2 s^-1
key_value_text.quote: 3.41+/-0.45(stat.)+0.48,-0.45(syst.) x10^6/(cm^2 s), 5.3 standard deviations greater than zero

significance.value: 5.3σ above zero (non-electron-flavour component of the 8B flux)
